_comment: Single source of geometry for both the CadQuery oracle and the SOLIDWORKS authoring scripts. Values tagged provisional_design are designer choices under design_then_inspect and must not reach cad/roboracer/parameters.csv.

clamp_engagement.basis: 1.75 x OD, mid-range of the 30-40 mm spec band rather than at its floor. Clamp fixity is the dominant risk in spec 6.3 and minimum engagement is where the fixed-end assumption is weakest; 35 mm costs nothing and buys margin.

support_sleeve._comment: Spec 6.1 requires an internal support over the clamped length: a 1.5 mm wall under a 16 N.m seating torque is unvalidated, and a crushed root changes I locally and softens exactly the region the hand calculation and the FEA both assume is rigid.

outer_diameter.basis: 0.05 mm clearance in the nominal 17 mm tube bore so the sleeve can be inserted

inner_diameter.basis: retains a cable path through the root rather than plugging the tube

length.basis: equals clamp_engagement so the support spans the full clamped length

bore_diameter.basis: 0.1 mm over nominal tube OD. A line-to-line 20.0 bore on a 20.0 tube is not a slip fit and, with the OD tolerance unverified and possibly positive, the tube may not enter at all. A split clamp closes 2 mm at the slot, so this clearance does not compromise grip. Replace with an H8 callout once the delivered OD is measured.

slot_width.basis: split gap allowing the clamp to close on the tube

slot_bottom_y.basis: runs to the bore centreline so the slot intersects the bore rather than meeting it tangentially; a tangent slot is degenerate and SOLIDWORKS auto-relations perturb the tangent corner

clamp_bolt_diameter.basis: M6 clearance, DIN 912 / ISO 4762 per spec Part 2

clamp_bolt_z.basis: two bolts distributed along the 35 mm engagement, 9 mm from each end

blocked_not_modelled.clamp_bolt_pitch: measurement - deck bolt pattern omitted from the clamp block
blocked_not_modelled.actual_load_height: measurement - Part 4 load feature not modelled
blocked_not_modelled.root_rotation_station_spacing: design_then_inspect, chosen 40.0 mm, but Part 4 not modelled this pass
